# Forbidden City Tours
> Expert guides to the best Forbidden City tours, tickets, and visitor tips in Beijing.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://forbidden-city-tour.com/): Compare guided tours, private VIP experiences, and half-day itineraries. 2026 ticket prices, opening hours, and insider tips.
- [Tours](https://forbidden-city-tour.com/tours/): All Forbidden City tours ranked and reviewed — group, private, VIP, half-day, photography.
- [Tickets](https://forbidden-city-tour.com/tickets/): Complete ticket buying guide: prices, online booking 7 days ahead, passport requirements.
- [Guide](https://forbidden-city-tour.com/guide/): Full visitor guide covering routes, what to see, and how to plan your day.
- [FAQ](https://forbidden-city-tour.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions about tickets, hours, accessibility, and photography.
